system.name: Virgo
system.one_liner: a GPU microarchitecture that disaggregates matrix units from SIMT cores to the cluster level for scalable, energy-efficient GEMM execution

components.name: Cluster
components.role: group of SIMT cores connected via a cluster-level network-on-chip to shared memory

components.name: SIMT Core
components.role: core consisting of a warp scheduler, register file, and tightly-coupled execution units like Tensor Cores

components.name: FPU
components.role: floating-point execution unit in the SIMT core

components.name: ALU
components.role: arithmetic logic execution unit in the SIMT core

components.name: Tensor Core
components.role: matrix unit tightly coupled to the SIMT core, receiving operands through the register file

components.name: Register File
components.role: supplies operands to execution units, including the Tensor Core, via the standard instruction datapath

components.name: Warps
components.role: warp storage/scheduling state in the SIMT core

components.name: Lanes
components.role: SIMT execution lanes of the core

components.name: TC
components.role: abbreviated Tensor Core shown in the other SIMT Core instances

components.name: Shared Memory
components.role: software-managed scratchpad shared by SIMT cores within a cluster

components.name: Matrix
components.role: matrix-related data resident in shared memory

components.name: Virgo Cluster
components.role: Virgo's cluster containing a disaggregated matrix unit instead of per-core Tensor Cores

components.name: Matrix Unit
components.role: dedicated matrix unit physically disaggregated from the SIMT core, integrated at the cluster level

components.name: Accumulator Memory
components.role: stores accumulator values for the disaggregated matrix unit, offloaded from the register file

components.name: PE Array
components.role: processing-element array performing the matrix multiply-add computation

components.name: Matrix Data
components.role: matrix operand data staged in shared memory for the matrix unit

content.key_idea: Contrasts today's GPU cluster, where Tensor Cores sit tightly coupled inside each SIMT core via the register file, with Virgo's cluster, where a single disaggregated Matrix Unit connects directly to shared memory.

evidence: we propose Virgo, a novel GPU architecture that integrates dedicated matrix units at the cluster level
Figure 1(a) shows the modern GPU microarchitecture, featuring multiple clusters of SIMT cores connected to a shared last-level cache.
Tensor Cores receive matrix operands directly through the register file of the SIMT core

summary: Figure 1 contrasts today's GPU cluster microarchitecture (a) with Virgo's proposed cluster (b). In (a), each SIMT core bundles a warp scheduler, register file, L1 cache, FPU/ALU units, and a tightly-coupled Tensor Core that receives matrix operands through the register file via the standard instruction datapath; several such cores share a cluster-level Shared Memory scratchpad, which connects to a Shared LLC. In (b), Virgo removes the Tensor Core from each SIMT core (leaving only Lanes) and instead places one disaggregated Matrix Unit, containing an Accumulator Memory and a PE Array, at the cluster level, wired with orange double-headed arrows directly to Shared Memory alongside Matrix Data. Both panels stack overlapping cluster rectangles to imply repetition across a chip, and the same Shared LLC box anchors both designs at the bottom.
summary_zh: 图1对比今日GPU集群与Virgo集群:(a)中每个SIMT核心内置紧耦合的Tensor Core,经寄存器文件与共享内存交互;(b)中Virgo将矩阵单元(含累加器内存和PE阵列)从核心中剥离,置于集群级并直接连接共享内存。
notes: Body text explains panel (a) and Virgo's general disaggregation idea well, but does not explicitly name panel (b)'s 'Accumulator Memory' or 'PE Array' labels; those are read from the image itself.
